description: Session-start version check (reports newer releases, safely applies an opted-in repository-scoped update, gives a verified reload handoff; silent when current), a per-session record of the plugin version this session has loaded (written at every session start and every prompt, read by the status line; at a prompt it also refreshes the newest-release cache in the background when older than 30 minutes and, once per new version, asks Claude to tell or ask the person about a reload or update, changing nothing itself; fails open), a prompt-time session gate (one job class per session: an authoring job and an execution job do not share a session; fails open) and, only in a repository whose .claude/ds-config.json names a presence command, a presence report for every session (at session start, each prompt, each finished turn and session end, plus a detached per-session keeper every few minutes while the session's process lives; the repository's command decides what a report means; fails open). Every operation is bounded.
